## isva-p05-v42 — argument map

**Speaker.** Pūrvapakṣin (svabhāva-vādin)

**Question.** Seed to sprout — by what purpose?

**Premises.**
- Not from world-sustenance-purpose would it produce seed into sprout (na lokayātrābhiprāyāt janayed bījam aṅkuram).
- But by nature — such a kit is its cause, of such a kind (kiṃ tu svabhāvāt sā tasya sāmagrī hetur īdṛśaḥ).

**Inference.** Nature's kit suffices — the svabhāva position stated.
